description: I'm Ruhit Sarker, a student researcher and technology enthusiast from Bangladesh with a strong interest in astrophysics, space exploration, robotics, and AI. I'm a 2026 Genius Olympiad Global Finalist and have experience in research, innovation, and leading student projects. As the team leader, I aim to bring together my team's diverse skills and perspectives to develop creative, meaningful solutions to real-world challenges through NASA Space Apps Challenge.
